map.女性为什么必须量臀围？: Why must women measure hip circumference?
map.女性脂肪分布与男性不同，加入臀围才能从围度合理推算体脂；漏测臀围或腰臀测量错位都: Women's fat distribution differs from men's, so hip circumference is needed to derive body fat reasonably from circumferences; missing the hip measurement or misaligning the waist and hip will bias the result, so hip circumference is required for women.
